newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait says oil foreign partnership talks ongoing.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait says oil foreign partnership talks ongoing.

text.p: Oil minister Abdul-Mohsen al-Mudej said on Tuesday Kuwait is still discussing foreign partnership in production operations, the official Kuwait News Agency said.
"The issue of foreign partnership in production operations and other (operations) is still on and it is being discussed," the agency quoted Mudej as saying at a news conference.
Kuwait has been in talks for two years with major foreign oil companies to study the prospects of partnerships in oil production and exploration.
Experts say envisaged partnerships could be in the form of a share in oil production or a fee in return for transfer of expertise and participation in the financing of exploration and production.
Parliament is expected to oppose any expansion of foreign involvement in the oil sector.
